name: lumen-tiny-mind
lines: lumen is a browser desktop mock with original glass chrome
aura is a local helper loaded at boot not a branded assistant
open files to browse the mock volume
open notes to write text stored in this browser
open gallery to add mock apps to the dock
open shelf to install original tools
press command space to talk to aura
press f3 for mission control and f4 for launchpad
glass tint lives in the control menu
wallpaper scenes cycle with command w
this page is entertainment only and not an apple product
icons here are original svg marks not official system icons
ask for the time the date or a small math problem
reminders and notes stay on this device
the tiny mind is a bigram model trained on these lines
